digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge API surface (library, MCP, CLI)
propositions: Noun-based bridge operations (preview, sync, status, pause, resume, check_access) must be exported as public library functions with typed inputs and structured results.
New bridge operations must be registered as MCP tools with explicit options and schema-backed outputs, reusing the canonical run_pass() disposition logic without duplication or subprocess delegation.

Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck() must remain callable with their existing signatures, defaults, return types, exceptions, and mutation boundaries while internally mapping to new bridge semantics.
Every mutating bridge operation (new and legacy) must respect mcp.allow_jira_sync authorization gate; read-only operations (preview, status, fsck, access-check) must not be rejected by that gate.
Documentation and README must present noun-based bridge operations as primary API while explicitly documenting retained legacy entrypoints as supported compatibility layers.
